gloss.en: When AI grows powerful, its makers pause and watch it warily.
gloss.zh: 当AI强大起来，创造者也要停下审视。

why_now.en: You track AI governance: today OpenAI halts Astra over safety standards and lays out its cyber evaluations in parallel — a concrete safety checkpoint.
why_now.zh: 你关注AI治理：今日OpenAI因安全标准暂停Astra并发布网络评估，安全节点明确。

phrase.en: companies scramble to cut AI spend

gloss.en: Companies feel the burn of token bills and hunt for ways to ease the pain.
gloss.zh: 企业感受到Token账单的压力，寻求缓解之策。

why_now.en: You care about AI economics: Databricks' 70% coding spend cut and the industry-wide ‘tokenpocalypse’ frame a cost reckoning that touches every AI adopter today.
why_now.zh: 你关注AI经济：Databricks削减70%编码支出与‘Token危机’共同描绘成本清算，影响所有AI使用者。

phrase.en: speaker uses moving parts to feel alive
phrase.zh: 音箱用活动部件显生气

gloss.en: New interfaces aim to make machines feel intuitive, alive, and safe to steer.
gloss.zh: 新界面旨在让机器更直觉、有生气、易掌控。

why_now.en: Your field overlaps with HCI: today brings teleoperation, pose analytics, and an AI speaker with moving parts — all pushing interaction frontiers you may build…
why_now.zh: 你关注人机交互：今日远程操作、姿态分析和动态AI音箱都在推进交互前沿，或可借鉴。

phrase.zh: 机器人从人类示范学习

gloss.en: Machines learn human-like skills through demonstrations, moving closer to natural interaction.
gloss.zh: 机器通过示范学习类人技能，更接近自然交互。

why_now.en: Your interest in embodied AI: today's papers show robots learning from human handwriting and teleoperation interfaces — concrete steps for human-robot…
why_now.zh: 你关注具身AI：今日论文展示机器人从手写轨迹和远程操作中学习，人机协作再进一步。

phrase.en: rapper admits AI in song creation

gloss.en: Art and immersive displays reframe how we see and question reality.
gloss.zh: 艺术与沉浸式展示重新定义我们看待和质疑现实的方式。

why_now.en: You explore critical visualization: cross-reality transitions in digital art and AI’s new creative tools (like Fenix Flexin's admitted AI use) challenge…
why_now.zh: 你关注批判性可视化：数字艺术跨现实转换和AI创意工具（如Fenix承认用AI）今日挑战传统视觉叙事。
